Lessons check: lesson 1 (hidden or golden-only demand) - no instance found; lesson 13 - only http://localhost:3000 and 127.0.0.1 appear under tests/ (grep); lesson 12 notes voice and lesson 16 double-penalty belong to rows 1 and 28.

NOTES (interpretations checked, not defects): (a) hro_reject_reason (functional/judge.toml:85) grades undoing a rejection; the rules place rejection under 'Moving a card' (rules:49-53, where 'Whenever a move is turned down' covers the blank-reason refusal) and undo 'gives back a rejection reason the move removed' (rules:100), and instruction.md:3,13 say 'move and reject cards ... undo my last move'; supported, mild wording ambiguity only. (b) hro_add_candidate (judge.toml:40) 'entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details' is grounded in rules:32 (source is a required input) and rules:108 (opening a card shows its details); the conditional phrasing avoids requiring a specific surface. (c) hro_refusal_status (judge.toml:202) requires 403 for Ingrid's other-job send replay; rules:22-24 reserve 404 for candidates, so a staff 404 is not a conforming alternative under the brief. (d) hro_pol_session_resume (polish/judge.toml:61) requires that Mei not see Rafael's unsaved NOTE draft; rules:110 'keep it for me on that browser' (per-user) supports it, though the explicit 'nobody else ... sees' sentence (rules:180) concerns replies. Conforming alternatives tried against the text: a 'Seen'-only tick, own routes and labels, a combined multi-card Activity line, refuse-before-move UI, a staff identifier in the 409 body, sign-out per tab - each is explicitly accepted by its criterion. No criterion found that false-fails an app satisfying the public brief. Source review only; no configured judge run measured how the judge applies these texts (that runtime evidence belongs to other rows).
